display_long_description:
Become a dragon!

In DragonRunners your hands are a dragon's claws and your head steers the flight. Squeeze the right trigger to take off and speed up, the left to brake, and look where you want to go. Land to walk on your claws, hop, pounce and climb rocks.

A new map every day
Islands, ruins, bridges, rings and skies change daily: sunrise, dusk, starry nights.

Three ways to play
- Tag (La Traes): one dragon starts as lava. Touch another dragon to pass the lava on and try to be lava-free when the round ends.
- Race: fly through the rings on a short or a long course.
- Free flight: explore with no rules.
Right grip: a burst of speed toward where you look.

Play together or alone
Online rooms of up to 10 players, private rooms by code, or offline against bots. Optional proximity voice, with push-to-talk.

Nine dragons, your style
Ember, Frost, Tempest, Umbra, Prism, Moss, Bulwark, Dawn and the legendary Eclipse. Customize colors, patterns, trails and lava color in your wardrobe. Scales, the currency for cosmetics, come as gifts, online Tag rewards (up to 50 a day) or optional purchases. They give no advantage and nothing is random.

Fair play and safety tools
All dragons fly the same. Mute and block players, or report human ones (not bots), from your wrist. Voice is never recorded. Comfort vignette on by default; the camera never tilts.

Played standing, with Touch controllers. In 33 languages, including English and Spanish.
